unclaimedDevicesTray.title: Unclaimed devices
unclaimedDevicesTray.allClaimedDescription: Devices that self-register will appear here.
unclaimedDevicesTray.claimValidation: Enter a name and pick a group

devices.pageSubtitle: Every screen across your network, with live status.
devices.emptyDescription: Adjust filters, or wait for devices to self-register.
devices.deleteConfirmDescription: Removes this device record. The APK on the TV will re-register on next boot.
devices.playlistSectionDescription: Overrides group- and address-level assignment for this device only. Clear to fall back to inherited.

addresses.pageSubtitle: Physical locations. Each address can contain multiple groups.
addresses.emptyDescription: Create your first address to start organizing devices.
addresses.deleteConfirmDescription: Removes this address and cascades to all groups. Devices in those groups will become unclaimed.
addresses.noGroupsDescription: Groups subdivide an address. A clinic might have 'Lobby' and 'Cafeteria' groups.

groups.pageSubtitle: Zones inside an address — a clinic's Lobby and Cafeteria, say.
groups.emptyDescription: Create groups from an address detail page.
groups.noDevicesDescription: Devices self-register and appear as unclaimed. Claim them from Overview or the Devices list.
groups.deleteConfirmDescription: Devices in this group will become unclaimed (their group_id will be set to null).

playlists.pageSubtitle: Ordered lists of media that TVs loop. Assign to a device, group, or address.
playlists.emptyDescription: Create a playlist and add media items to it.
playlists.deleteConfirmDescription: Removes this playlist and all its items. Assignments to this playlist will also be removed.
playlists.mediaLibraryHint: Click a tile to append it to the playlist.
playlists.emptyPlaylistDescription: Pick media from the left panel to add items.

media.pageSubtitle: Upload videos and images. Playlists reference media from this library.
media.emptyDescription: Upload videos or images to start building playlists.

users.copyFailedDescription: Select and copy the password manually.
